mapper.sql: CASE WHEN CAST(a.status AS CHAR) IN ('0', 'published', 'online', 'ONLINE', 'PUBLISHED') THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status_normalized
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcement ORDER BY COALESCE(is_top, 0) DESC, sort_order ASC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM announcement ORDER BY COALESCE(is_top, 0) DESC, sort_order ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM announcement WHERE -- 兼容整数（0=发布, 1=草稿）和字符串（published/draft） ( CAST(COALESCE(status, '') AS CHAR) IN ('0', 'published', 'ONLINE', 'PUBLISHED', 'online') ) ORDER BY COALESCE(is_top, 0) DESC, COALESCE(sort_order, 0) ASC, COALESCE(publish_time, create_time) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement (title, content, type, is_top, status, sort_order, publish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{publishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, is_top = #{isTop}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE announcement SET status = #{status}, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('published', 'online') OR #{status} = '0' THEN COALESCE(publish_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE publish_time END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
